items.q: In the epithelium schematic, which type is a single layer of flat cells suited to diffusion?
items.exp: Simple squamous epithelium is one flat layer, thin enough for diffusion and filtration.

items.q: In the glands schematic, which mode of secretion releases the whole cell with its product?
items.exp: Holocrine glands shed the entire secretory cell; sebaceous glands are the classic example.
items.kp: Holocrine glands shed the entire secretory cell; sebaceous glands are the classic example.
